title: AEP to Invest $4B in 702 MW Bloom Energy Fuel Cell Plant for Google in Wyoming
content: AEP plans to invest $4 billion in a 702 MW Bloom Energy fuel cell plant near Cheyenne to power Google under a 20-year PPA, with carbon capture targets.

title: Green Hydrogen Production Advances with 2.5 MW Electrolyzer Launch in Navarra
content: Nordex Electrolyzers unveiled the NX2500, a 2.5 MW pressurized alkaline electrolyzer fully designed and tested in Navarra, marking a domestic manufacturing milestone in green hydrogen production.

title: India’s Green Hydrogen Production Stumbles on Standards Gaps, BCG Warns
content: BCG and India’s MNRE mapped 166 standards across 20 components, flagging 23 gaps in green hydrogen production, transport, storage and end uses, and proposed adopt/adapt/develop routes.

title: GeoPura secures offtake from Bradford’s 35 MW green hydrogen electrolyser
content: GeoPura will offtake 15% and then 20% of output from Hygen Energy’s 35 MW Bradford electrolyser under a 15-year government subsidy, securing fuel for its hydrogen power units ahead of a pending final investment decision.
